learn.h:
🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质

One bottle label says "colourless liquid" and also "highly flammable" — one line tells you what the liquid is like, the other tells you what it can turn into.同一个瓶子的标签上写着「无色液体」，又写着「高度易燃」——一句告诉你它长什么样，另一句告诉你它能变成什么。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  1. Physical property: observe or measure, substance unchanged (colour, density, mp, bp, hardness).物理性质：观察或测量，物质不变（颜色、密度、熔点、沸点、硬度）。
  2. Chemical property: how it reacts to form a new substance (rusts, burns, reacts with acid, tarnishes).化学性质：能怎样反应生成新物质（生锈、燃烧、与酸反应、变暗）。
  3. Matter has mass and takes up space; energy (heat, light) is not matter.物质有质量、占空间；能量（热、光）不是物质。
Physical property 物理性质
🎨 colour 颜色
🌡️ melting point 熔点
⚖️ density 密度
vs
Chemical property 化学性质
🔥 flammable 易燃
🟤 rusts 会生锈
🧪 reacts with acid 与酸反应

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  • Properties of matter物质的性质
    • Physical property物理性质observe or measure — no new substance观察或测量——不生成新物质
      • colour, lustre颜色、光泽
      • density, hardness, viscosity密度、硬度、黏度
      • melting point, boiling point熔点、沸点
      • state at room temperature室温下的状态
    • Chemical property化学性质how it reacts to form a new substance能怎样反应、生成新物质
      • ability to rust会生锈
      • ability to burn (flammable)能燃烧（易燃）
      • reacts with acid / water与酸／水反应
      • tarnishes in air在空气中变暗（失去光泽）

🧗 The hard part难点 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质

A property is an ability, not an event性质是能力，不是正在发生的事

Students think a chemical property must be happening in front of them.学生以为化学性质必须正在眼前发生。

  1. Ask: would testing this make a new substance?问：检测这个性质会生成新物质吗？
  2. Yes → chemical property, even if the sample is just sitting there.会 → 化学性质，哪怕样品现在只是放着。
  3. No → physical property.不会 → 物理性质。
Try试一试
"Sodium reacts violently with water." P or C?「钠遇水剧烈反应。」物理还是化学？
Answer答案
Chemical property.化学性质。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  • "Gasoline is flammable" → physical (nothing is burning) ✗ → chemical (ability to burn) ✓「汽油易燃」→ 物理（又没在烧）✗ → 化学（能燃烧的能力）✓
🎯
Underline the verb in the statement — it usually gives the answer away.圈出句子里的动词——答案通常就藏在里面。

🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质

A gold ring and a gold bar have very different masses, yet both have exactly the same density — so which properties care about "how much" and which do not?金戒指和金条的质量差很多，密度却完全一样——哪些性质跟「有多少」有关，哪些无关？

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质
  1. Extensive = depends on amount (mass, volume, length, surface area).广延＝与量有关（质量、体积、长度、表面积）。
  2. Intensive = amount does not matter (density, mp, bp, colour, temperature, viscosity).强度＝与量无关（密度、熔点、沸点、颜色、温度、黏度）。
  3. Test: cut it in half — value halves → E; stays the same → I.判断：切一半——数值减半 → 广延；不变 → 强度。
D=Vm​
Extensive 广延性质
📦 changes with amount 随量而变
mass 质量
volume 体积
length 长度
vs
Intensive 强度性质
🔒 same for any amount 与量无关
density 密度
melting point, boiling point 熔点、沸点
colour, temperature 颜色、温度

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质
  • Physical properties物理性质
    • Extensive广延性质more stuff → bigger value东西越多 → 数值越大
      • mass质量
      • volume体积
      • length, surface area长度、表面积
    • Intensive强度性质amount does not matter多少都一样
      • density密度
      • melting point, boiling point熔点、沸点
      • colour, temperature, viscosity颜色、温度、黏度

🧗 The hard part难点 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质

Why density is intensive为什么密度是强度性质

A bigger object is heavier, so students think density grows too.物体越大越重，学生就以为密度也变大。

  1. Double the sample: m→2m, V→2V.样品加倍：m→2m，V→2V。
  2. D=2V2m​=Vm​ — unchanged.D=2V2m​=Vm​——不变。
Try试一试
Water: 10 g in 10 mL, and 250 g in 250 mL. Densities?水：10 g 占 10 mL，250 g 占 250 mL。密度各是多少？
Answer答案
Both 1.0 g/mL.都是 1.0 g/mL。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质
  • Temperature → extensive ✗ → intensive ✓ (a cup and a tub can both be 40 °C)温度 → 广延 ✗ → 强度 ✓（一杯和一缸都可以是 40 °C）
🎯
Density = extensive ÷ extensive, so it is intensive.密度＝广延÷广延，所以是强度性质。

🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Melting chocolate and burning toast both happen in a kitchen with heat — but only one of them gives you something you can never turn back into the original.巧克力熔化和吐司烤焦都在厨房里、都靠加热——但只有一个变出了再也变不回原样的东西。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  1. Chemical change: new substance forms; hard to get the original back.化学变化：生成新物质；难以复原。
  2. Physical change: same substance; only form, phase or appearance changes.物理变化：同种物质；只改变形状、相或外观。
  3. All phase changes are physical. Bubbles, heat or colour are clues, not proof.所有相变都是物理变化。气泡、放热、变色只是线索，不是证据。
Physical change 物理变化
🧊 melting 熔化
💨 evaporating 汽化
✂️ cutting 切割
same substance 还是同一种物质
vs
Chemical change 化学变化
🔥 burning 燃烧
🍳 frying an egg 煎蛋
🟤 rusting 生锈
new substance 生成新物质

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  • Changes in matter物质的变化
    • Physical change物理变化no new substance; form or phase changes没有新物质；形状或相改变
      • melting, freezing, boiling, condensing熔化、凝固、沸腾、液化
      • cutting, crushing, dissolving切割、压碎、溶解
    • Chemical change化学变化new substance; hard to get the original back生成新物质；难以复原
      • burning, rusting, tarnishing燃烧、生锈、变暗
      • cooking an egg, leaves changing colour煎蛋、树叶变色
      • clues: gas, precipitate, heat/light, new colour线索：气体、沉淀、放热发光、变色

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Deciding physical or chemical判断物理变化还是化学变化

🧗 The hard part难点 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Clues vs proof线索与证据

Students treat any bubbles, heat or colour change as automatic proof of a chemical change.学生把任何气泡、放热、变色都当成化学变化的铁证。

  1. Spot the clue (gas, heat, colour, solid).找到线索（气体、热、颜色、固体）。
  2. Ask: is it a new substance, or the same substance in a new phase?问：是新物质，还是同种物质换了相？
  3. New → chemical; same → physical.新的 → 化学；相同 → 物理。
Try试一试
A kettle gives off a cloud of steam. Chemical?水壶冒出一团蒸气。是化学变化吗？
Answer答案
No — water turning to vapour and back to droplets is physical.不是——水变成蒸气又凝成小水滴，是物理变化。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  • Boiling makes gas → chemical ✗ → water vapour is still water → physical ✓沸腾产生气体 → 化学 ✗ → 水蒸气仍是水 → 物理 ✓
  • Broken glass cannot be undone → chemical ✗ → still glass → physical ✓碎玻璃复原不了 → 化学 ✗ → 仍是玻璃 → 物理 ✓
🎯
Ask "what is it made of afterwards?" — if the answer is the same name, it is physical.问「之后它是什么？」——名字没变就是物理变化。

quiz.q: Density, melting point and colour are examples of ______ properties.密度、熔点和颜色是______性质的例子。
quiz.a: physical物理
quiz.sol: • None of them needs a new substance to form → physical.它们都不需要生成新物质 → 物理性质。
quiz.goal: Recall the class examples of physical properties.记住课上列出的物理性质例子。
quiz.idea: All three are measured or seen without changing the substance.三者都不用改变物质就能测量或看到。

quiz.q: Which one is NOT matter?下面哪一个不是物质？
c: air in a balloon气球里的空气
a drop of water一滴水
the heat from a stove炉子散发的热
a grain of salt一粒盐
quiz.a: the heat from a stove炉子散发的热
quiz.sol: • Heat is energy: no mass, takes up no space → not matter. Air, water, salt all have mass.热是能量：没有质量、不占空间 → 不是物质。空气、水、盐都有质量。
quiz.goal: Use the definition of matter to rule out energy.用物质的定义排除能量。
quiz.idea: Matter needs mass and volume; heat has neither.物质要有质量和体积；热两样都没有。

quiz.q: "Diamond is extremely hard." Physical or chemical property?「钻石极其坚硬。」是物理性质还是化学性质？
quiz.a: physical物理性质
quiz.sol: • Testing hardness does not form a new substance → physical property.测硬度不生成新物质 → 物理性质。
quiz.goal: Classify hardness.判断硬度属于哪类性质。
quiz.idea: A scratch test leaves diamond still diamond.划痕测试后，钻石还是钻石。

quiz.q: "Baking soda fizzes and gives off a gas when vinegar is added." Physical or chemical property of baking soda?「在小苏打里加醋，会冒泡放出气体。」这是小苏打的物理性质还是化学性质？
quiz.a: chemical化学性质
quiz.sol: • Reacting with an acid to form a new gas → chemical property.与酸反应生成新气体 → 化学性质。
quiz.goal: Recognise "reacts with acid" as a chemical property.认出「与酸反应」是化学性质。
quiz.idea: Vinegar is an acid; a new gas forms.醋是酸；生成了新的气体。

quiz.q: Which statement describes a chemical property?哪一句描述的是化学性质？
c: Honey has a high viscosity.蜂蜜黏度高。
Aluminum can be hammered into foil.铝能被锤成箔。
Copper can be drawn into wire.铜能被拉成丝。
Wood can burn in air.木头能在空气中燃烧。
quiz.a: Wood can burn in air.木头能在空气中燃烧。
quiz.sol: • Viscosity, malleability (foil), ductility (wire) are physical. Ability to burn → chemical.黏度、可锻性（压成箔）、延性（拉成丝）是物理性质。能燃烧 → 化学性质。
quiz.goal: Tell chemical from the physical properties of Topic 2.把化学性质与第 2 课的物理性质区分开。
quiz.idea: Viscosity, malleability, ductility are physical; burning makes new substances.黏度、可锻性、延性是物理性质；燃烧生成新物质。

quiz.q: "Ice floats on water because it is less dense." Is this a physical or chemical property, and what is the property?「冰浮在水上，因为它密度比水小。」这是物理性质还是化学性质？具体是什么性质？
quiz.a: Physical property — density.物理性质——密度。
quiz.sol: • The property is density. Measuring it does not change HX2​O into anything new → physical.性质是密度。测量它不会把 HX2​O 变成别的东西 → 物理性质。
quiz.goal: Identify the hidden property (density) in an unfamiliar sentence.从陌生句子里找出隐含的性质（密度）。
quiz.idea: Floating is explained by density, which is measured without changing the water.漂浮是由密度解释的，测密度不改变水。

quiz.q: Classify: "Hydrogen peroxide slowly breaks down into water and oxygen when left in light."分类：「过氧化氢放在光下会慢慢分解成水和氧气。」
quiz.a: chemical property化学性质
quiz.sol: • Two new substances form, so this describes how it reacts → chemical property.生成了两种新物质，描述的是它如何反应 → 化学性质。
quiz.goal: Classify an unfamiliar breakdown as a chemical property.判断陌生的分解现象属于化学性质。
quiz.idea: Breaking into water and oxygen = new substances form.分解成水和氧气＝生成了新物质。

quiz.q: Two unlabelled clear liquids are on the lab bench. Suggest one physical property and one chemical property you could test to tell them apart, and say which test leaves the sample unchanged.实验台上有两瓶无标签的透明液体。各举一个可以用来区分它们的物理性质和化学性质，并说明哪种测试不会改变样品。
quiz.a: e.g. physical: boiling point or density (sample unchanged); chemical: flammability (sample becomes new substances).例如物理：沸点或密度（样品不变）；化学：可燃性（样品变成新物质）。
quiz.sol:
• Physical property test: measure each boiling point or density. The liquid is still the same substance afterwards.物理性质测试：测各自的沸点或密度，之后液体还是原来的物质。
  • Chemical property test: see if a small drop burns. Burning turns it into new substances, so that part of the sample is gone.化学性质测试：看一小滴能否燃烧。燃烧会把它变成新物质，那部分样品就没了。
quiz.goal: Apply both kinds of property to plan a simple lab test.运用两类性质设计简单的实验鉴别。
quiz.idea: Physical tests (boiling point, density, odour) keep the sample; chemical tests (does it burn?) use it up.物理测试（沸点、密度、气味）样品不变；化学测试（能否燃烧）会消耗样品。

quiz.q: A property that depends on how much substance you have is called ______.与物质多少有关的性质叫做______性质。
quiz.a: extensive广延
quiz.sol: • Depends on amount → extensive.随量变化 → 广延性质。
quiz.goal: Recall the term extensive.记住「广延性质」这个术语。
quiz.idea: Extensive = extends with the amount.广延＝随量「延伸」。

quiz.q: Which is an intensive property?下面哪个是强度性质？
c: mass质量
volume体积
melting point熔点
length长度
quiz.a: melting point熔点
quiz.sol: • Mass, volume and length grow with amount; melting point (0 °C for ice) does not → intensive.质量、体积、长度随量增大；熔点（冰为 0 °C）不变 → 强度性质。
quiz.goal: Recognise a listed intensive property.认出清单上的强度性质。
quiz.idea: A small and a large ice cube melt at the same temperature.大冰块和小冰块在同一温度熔化。

quiz.q: Viscosity of motor oil: extensive or intensive?机油的黏度：广延还是强度性质？
quiz.a: intensive强度性质
quiz.sol: • Resistance to flow is the same for any amount → intensive.无论多少，抵抗流动的程度都一样 → 强度性质。
quiz.goal: Classify viscosity.判断黏度的类型。
quiz.idea: A spoonful of oil flows just as slowly as a litre.一勺油和一升油流得一样慢。

quiz.q: Total length of copper wire used in a circuit: extensive or intensive?电路中所用铜线的总长度：广延还是强度性质？
quiz.a: extensive广延性质
quiz.sol: • Length grows with the amount of wire → extensive.长度随线的多少变化 → 广延性质。
quiz.goal: Classify a "total" quantity.判断「总量」类的性质。
quiz.idea: More wire → longer total length.线越多 → 总长度越长。

quiz.q: Boiling point of sea water: extensive or intensive? (Sea water is a mixture.)海水的沸点：广延还是强度性质？（海水是混合物。）
quiz.a: intensive强度性质
quiz.sol: • Taking half of the same sea water does not change its boiling point → intensive.同样的海水取一半，沸点不变 → 强度性质。
quiz.goal: Apply the test to a mixture, not only a pure substance.把判断方法用到混合物上，而不只是纯净物。
quiz.idea: A cup and a bucket of the same sea water boil at the same temperature.同样的海水，一杯和一桶的沸点一样。

quiz.q: A 50.0 g piece of aluminum has a volume of 18.5 mL (density = mass ÷ volume). What is the density of a 25.0 g piece of the same aluminum, in g/mL (nearest hundredth)?一块 50.0 g 的铝体积为 18.5 mL（密度＝质量÷体积）。同样的铝取 25.0 g，它的密度是多少 g/mL（保留两位小数）？
quiz.a: 2.70 g/mL
quiz.sol: • D=50.0÷18.5≈2.70 g/mL. Density is intensive, so the 25.0 g piece is also 2.70 g/mL.D=50.0÷18.5≈2.70 g/mL。密度是强度性质，所以 25.0 g 那块也是 2.70 g/mL。
quiz.goal: Use the fact that density is intensive to avoid extra work.利用密度是强度性质，省去多余计算。
quiz.idea: Same substance → same density, whatever the mass.同种物质 → 密度相同，与质量无关。

quiz.q: A lab group records for one ice cube: mass 12 g, temperature −5 °C, colour white, volume 13 mL, melting point 0 °C. Sort all five into extensive and intensive, then say which two you would compare to show another cube is the same substance.一个小组记录了一块冰：质量 12 g、温度 −5 °C、白色、体积 13 mL、熔点 0 °C。把这五项分成广延和强度两类，再说明要证明另一块冰是同种物质，应该比较哪两项。
quiz.a: Extensive: mass, volume. Intensive: temperature, colour, melting point. Compare intensive ones, e.g. melting point and colour (or density).广延：质量、体积。强度：温度、颜色、熔点。要比较强度性质，例如熔点和颜色（或密度）。
quiz.sol:
• A bigger cube has more mass and volume → extensive. Temperature, colour, melting point do not depend on size → intensive.更大的冰块质量和体积更大 → 广延。温度、颜色、熔点与大小无关 → 强度。
  • To identify the substance use intensive properties such as melting point and colour (density also works). Temperature is intensive but tells you about conditions, not identity.鉴别物质要用强度性质，比如熔点和颜色（密度也可以）。温度虽是强度性质，但反映的是所处条件，不是物质身份。
quiz.goal: Sort lab data and choose intensive properties to identify a substance.整理实验数据，并选用强度性质来鉴别物质。
quiz.idea: Only intensive properties identify a substance — extensive ones change with sample size.只有强度性质能鉴别物质——广延性质会随样品大小变化。

quiz.q: A change in which a new substance is formed is a ______ change.生成新物质的变化叫______变化。
quiz.a: chemical化学
quiz.sol: • New substance formed → chemical change.生成新物质 → 化学变化。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of chemical change.记住化学变化的定义。
quiz.idea: New substance = chemical.新物质＝化学。

quiz.q: Which describes a physical change?哪一句描述的是物理变化？
c: A new substance forms.生成新物质。
The substance stays the same; only its form or phase changes.物质不变，只是形状或相改变。
Heat and light are always given off.一定会放热发光。
The original can never be recovered.原物质永远无法复原。
quiz.a: The substance stays the same; only its form or phase changes.物质不变，只是形状或相改变。
quiz.sol: • Physical change = no new substance, only form/phase/appearance changes.物理变化＝没有新物质，只改变形状、相或外观。
quiz.goal: Recall the key idea of physical change.记住物理变化的核心特征。
quiz.idea: Same substance, different look or phase.同种物质，外观或相改变。

quiz.q: An egg is fried in a pan. Physical or chemical change?在平底锅里煎鸡蛋。物理变化还是化学变化？
quiz.a: chemical化学变化
quiz.sol: • Heat makes new substances in the egg (it goes white and firm for good) → chemical.加热使蛋里生成新物质（变白变硬且不可逆）→ 化学变化。
quiz.goal: Classify cooking.判断烹饪属于哪类变化。
quiz.idea: Cooked egg cannot become raw egg again.熟蛋变不回生蛋。

quiz.q: Liquid nitrogen evaporates into nitrogen gas. Physical or chemical change?液氮汽化成氮气。物理变化还是化学变化？
quiz.a: physical物理变化
quiz.sol: • NX2​(l)​NX2​(g) — same substance, new phase → physical.NX2​(l)​NX2​(g)——同种物质，换了相 → 物理变化。
quiz.goal: Recognise a phase change as physical.认出相变是物理变化。
quiz.idea: NX2​(l)​NX2​(g): still nitrogen.NX2​(l)​NX2​(g)：还是氮。

quiz.q: Sugar is stirred into hot tea and seems to disappear. Physical or chemical change?把糖搅进热茶里，糖好像消失了。物理变化还是化学变化？
quiz.a: physical物理变化
quiz.sol: • Sugar spreads out among the water particles but stays sugar (the tea tastes sweet); boiling off the water leaves it behind → physical.糖分散在水的粒子之间，但仍是糖（茶是甜的）；把水煮干糖就留下来 → 物理变化。
quiz.goal: Classify dissolving using what you know about solutions.用溶液的知识判断溶解属于哪类变化。
quiz.idea: A solution is a homogeneous MIXTURE — substances are physically combined.溶液是均匀混合物——各物质只是物理混合。

quiz.q: Which is a chemical change?哪一个是化学变化？
c: A glass falls and shatters.玻璃杯掉地摔碎。
Butter softens on a warm counter.黄油在温暖的台面上变软。
Food is digested in the stomach.食物在胃里被消化。
Water freezes in an ice tray.水在冰格里凝固。
quiz.a: Food is digested in the stomach.食物在胃里被消化。
quiz.sol: • Shattering: still glass (physical). Softening and freezing: phase/form only (physical). Digesting: food is broken down into new substances (chemical).摔碎：还是玻璃（物理）。软化、凝固：只改变形态或相（物理）。消化：食物被分解成新物质（化学）。
quiz.goal: Avoid the "cannot undo = chemical" trap.避开「复原不了＝化学变化」的陷阱。
quiz.idea: Shattered glass is still glass; digestion breaks food into new substances.碎玻璃还是玻璃；消化把食物分解成新物质。

quiz.q: Explain why shredding paper is a physical change but burning paper is a chemical change.解释为什么撕碎纸是物理变化，而烧纸是化学变化。
quiz.a: Shredded pieces are still paper (no new substance) → physical. Burning turns paper into ash, smoke and gases — new substances → chemical.碎纸片仍是纸（没有新物质）→ 物理变化。燃烧把纸变成灰、烟和气体——新物质 → 化学变化。
quiz.sol:
• Shredding changes only size and shape; every piece is still paper → physical.撕碎只改变大小和形状，每片都还是纸 → 物理变化。
  • Burning produces ash, smoke and gases that are not paper → chemical.燃烧生成灰、烟和气体，都不是纸 → 化学变化。
quiz.goal: Justify a classification with the "new substance" test.用「新物质」标准说明分类理由。
quiz.idea: Small pieces of paper are still paper; ash and smoke are not.纸片还是纸；灰和烟不是。

quiz.q: In a lab, two clear colourless solutions are mixed. A yellow solid appears and settles, and the beaker feels warm. (a) Write two observations. (b) Write one interpretation. (c) Physical or chemical change?实验中把两种无色透明溶液混合，出现黄色固体并沉到底部，烧杯摸起来变热。(a) 写出两条观察。(b) 写出一条解释。(c) 这是物理变化还是化学变化？
quiz.a: (a) A yellow solid formed; the beaker became warm. (b) A precipitate formed, so a reaction occurred (or: it is exothermic because heat was released). (c) Chemical change.(a) 生成黄色固体；烧杯变热。(b) 生成了沉淀，说明发生了反应（或：放出热量，所以是放热反应）。(c) 化学变化。
quiz.sol:
• Observations: yellow solid appeared and settled; beaker felt warm.观察：出现黄色固体并沉降；烧杯摸起来热。
  • Interpretation: the solid is a precipitate, a new substance, so a chemical reaction occurred; heat was released, so it is exothermic.解释：固体是沉淀，是新物质，所以发生了化学反应；放出了热，所以是放热反应。
  • A new substance formed → chemical change.生成了新物质 → 化学变化。
quiz.goal: Combine observation/interpretation (Topic 1) with classifying a change.把观察与解释（第 1 课）和变化的分类结合起来。
quiz.idea: Observations are what your senses detect; the interpretation explains them — a new solid (precipitate) means a new substance.观察是感官得到的；解释是给观察赋予意义——新的固体（沉淀）意味着新物质。

diag.q: Which is a physical property of copper?下面哪一项是铜的物理性质？
c: It turns green when left outside for years.在户外放置多年会变绿。
It conducts heat well.导热性好。
It reacts with nitric acid.能与硝酸反应。
It forms a black coating when heated in air.在空气中加热会形成一层黑色物质。
why: Turning green outdoors is copper reacting with air and water → chemical.在户外变绿是铜与空气和水反应 → 化学性质。
Correct: conducting heat can be measured without changing the copper.正确：导热性可以测量，铜本身不变。
Mistook "reacts with acid" for physical — any reaction forms a new substance.把「与酸反应」当成物理性质——凡反应都会生成新物质。
A new black coating is a new substance → chemical, not just a colour change.新生成的黑色涂层是新物质 → 化学性质，不只是颜色变化。
diag.goal: Pick the physical property among reaction-based distractors.在与反应有关的干扰项中挑出物理性质。
diag.idea: Only one option leaves copper as copper.只有一个选项里铜还是铜。

diag.q: A note says: "Magnesium is silver-grey, has a density of 1.7 g/mL, and burns with a bright white flame." How many chemical properties are listed?一张笔记写着：「镁呈银灰色，密度为 1.7 g/mL，燃烧时发出耀眼的白光。」其中列出了几个化学性质？
why: Missed that "burns" is a chemical property even inside a description.没意识到描述中的「燃烧」就是化学性质。
Correct: only "burns" forms new substances; colour and density are physical.正确：只有「燃烧」生成新物质；颜色和密度是物理性质。
Counted density as chemical because it has a number — numbers are measurements, so physical.因为密度带数字就当成化学性质——数字是测量值，属于物理性质。
Counted colour as chemical — colour is seen by looking, so physical.把颜色也当成化学性质——颜色用眼看就知道，是物理性质。
diag.goal: Count chemical properties inside a mixed description.在混合描述中数出化学性质。
diag.idea: Split the sentence into three properties and test each one.把句子拆成三个性质，逐个判断。

diag.q: Which pair are BOTH extensive?哪一组两项都是广延性质？
c: mass and density质量和密度
volume and surface area体积和表面积
colour and length颜色和长度
temperature and volume温度和体积
why: Thinks density grows with size — it does not.以为密度随大小变化——其实不会。
Correct: both get bigger with more substance.正确：两者都随物质增多而增大。
Thinks colour depends on amount — a big or small piece has the same colour.以为颜色与量有关——大块小块颜色一样。
Thinks a larger amount of water is "hotter" — temperature is intensive.以为水多就「更热」——温度是强度性质。
diag.goal: Identify extensive properties among common distractors.在常见干扰项中识别广延性质。
diag.idea: Both members must change when the sample is halved.两项都必须在样品减半时变化。

diag.q: Beaker A has 100 mL of water at 60 °C; beaker B has 400 mL of water at 60 °C. Which statement is true?烧杯 A 有 100 mL 60 °C 的水；烧杯 B 有 400 mL 60 °C 的水。哪句话正确？
c: B has the higher temperature because it has more water.B 的温度更高，因为水更多。
B has 4 times the density of A.B 的密度是 A 的 4 倍。
A and B have the same temperature and density, but B has 4 times the mass.A 和 B 温度、密度相同，但 B 的质量是 A 的 4 倍。
A and B have the same mass because they are both water.A 和 B 质量相同，因为都是水。
why: Treats temperature as extensive.把温度当成广延性质。
Treats density as extensive.把密度当成广延性质。
Correct: temperature and density are intensive; mass is extensive and scales with volume (400 ÷ 100 = 4).正确：温度和密度是强度性质；质量是广延性质，随体积变化（400÷100＝4）。
Confuses "same substance" with "same amount" — mass depends on amount.把「同种物质」和「同样多」混为一谈——质量取决于量。
diag.goal: Apply both types to two samples of different size.对两份大小不同的样品同时运用两类性质。
diag.idea: Sort each quantity first: temperature I, density I, mass E.先给每个量分类：温度 I、密度 I、质量 E。

diag.q: Which is a physical change?哪一个是物理变化？
c: A nail rusts outside.钉子在户外生锈。
Bread is toasted until brown.面包烤到焦黄。
Butter melts in a hot pan.黄油在热锅里熔化。
A cake bakes in the oven.蛋糕在烤箱里烤熟。
why: Rusting makes a new substance (rust) → chemical.生锈生成新物质（铁锈）→ 化学变化。
Browning toast is cooking: new substances → chemical. Colour change here is a real reaction.烤焦是烹饪：生成新物质 → 化学变化。这里的变色是真的反应。
Correct: solid butter → liquid butter, a phase change.正确：固态黄油 → 液态黄油，是相变。
Baking turns batter into new substances → chemical; heat alone does not mean physical.烘烤把面糊变成新物质 → 化学变化；用了加热不代表就是物理变化。
diag.goal: Pick the physical change among cooking and rusting.在烹饪、生锈中挑出物理变化。
diag.idea: Look for the phase change.找出相变。

diag.q: Water is heated and bubbles rise to the top. A student says, "Gas is produced, so this is a chemical change." Best reply?水被加热，气泡往上冒。某学生说：「产生了气体，所以是化学变化。」最好的回答是？
c: Agree — any gas means a chemical change.同意——只要有气体就是化学变化。
Disagree — the gas is water vapour, the same substance in a new phase, so it is physical.不同意——气体是水蒸气，同种物质换了相，所以是物理变化。
Agree — you cannot easily get the water back.同意——水很难再变回来。
Disagree — it would only be chemical if the water reached 200 °C.不同意——只有水达到 200 °C 才算化学变化。
why: Treats a clue (gas) as proof without asking what the gas is.把线索（气体）当证据，没问气体是什么。
Correct: HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g), no new substance.正确：HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g)，没有新物质。
Wrong reversibility: cooling the vapour easily gives water back.对可逆性判断错误：把水蒸气冷却就能轻易得到水。
Thinks temperature decides the type of change; it is the new substance that decides.以为温度决定变化类型；其实看的是有没有新物质。
diag.goal: Reason about a misleading clue.对有误导性的线索进行推理。
diag.idea: Identify the gas before classifying.先确定气体是什么，再分类。
